defs.def: a large important organization that has a particular purpose, for example, a university or bank （大学、银行等规模大的）机构

ex.s: The research, carried out by scientists at the Columbia Climate School and other institutions, found that if the city maintains past species patterns in new plantings, isoprene production in Manhattan in coming decades will go up by about 140%, and resulting summer ozone levels as much as 30%.
ex.t: 这项由哥伦比亚气候学院及其他机构的科学家开展的研究发现，如果该市在新种植中沿用过去的树种模式，未来几十年曼哈顿的异戊二烯产量将上升约140%，由此导致的夏季臭氧水平最多将上升30%。

ex.s: present a letter from a technical institution
ex.t: 出示一份来自技术院校的证明信

ex.s: For many British people, that can apply to institutions and objects that represent their country’s past-age-old castles, splendid homes… and red phone boxes.
ex.t: 对许多英国人来说，这同样适用于代表他们国家过去的机构和物品——古老的城堡、华丽的宅邸……以及红色电话亭。

ex.s: Einstein, who was Jewish, found the doors of academic institutions closed to him.
ex.t: 作为犹太人的爱因斯坦发现学术机构的大门对他关闭了。

ex.s: On most UK high streets, for example, you will often come across people raising money and looking for volunteers for Cancer Research UK, the British Heart Foundation, the Royal National Lifeboat Institution and many more.
ex.t: 例如，在英国大多数商业街上，你常会遇到为英国癌症研究中心、英国心脏基金会、皇家全国救生艇协会等机构募款和招募志愿者的人。

defs.def: a building where people with special needs are taken care of, for example because they are old or mentally ill 慈善机构；社会福利机构
a custom or system that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people （由来已久的）风俗习惯，制度
the act of starting or introducing sth such as a system or a law 建立；设立；制订
a person who is well known because they have been in a particular place or job for a long time （某地或某工作领域）出名的人

ex.s: Applicants in technical assignments must have reached the last year of their studies in a technical institution．
ex.t: 技术岗位的申请人必须已进入技术院校学习的最后一年。
